# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 25 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Seth Makes the Tablets

---

**1** Seth did as his mother Eve commanded and made tablets of stone and of clay, writing on them all the deeds of his father and mother.

**2** Seth was a righteous man who feared God all his days and walked in all the ways of his father Adam.

**3** After Eve's death, Seth lived on and continued to multiply and fill the earth.

**4** Seth lived nine hundred and twelve years.

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
